zh: 关闭的商家完全不参与排名，先把它们过滤掉。
剩下的按三个关键字排序：评分降序；评分相同时距离升序；再相同时按原输入下标升序。这样排名是唯一确定的。
收集所有营业商家的下标，用自定义比较排序，然后输出前 K 个与营业数中较小者那么多个下标，以空格分隔；没有可输出的下标时输出空行。
en: Closed merchants take no part in the ranking, so filter them out first.
Sort the rest by three keys: rating descending, then distance ascending on equal ratings, then original index ascending. This makes the ranking unique.

Collect the indices of the open merchants, sort them with a custom comparison, and print the first min(K, number open) indices separated by spaces; print an empty line when there is nothing to output.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Filter out the closed merchants, sort by the three ranking keys, and take the first K indices.

## Correctness

Filtering removes exactly the options that cannot be chosen; the sort applies the comparison priorities required by the problem level by level, so the resulting prefix is the unique valid top K.

## Complexity

Time O(N log N), space O(N).
